verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor documentation describing per-channel, per-keyword, or scheduled notification tuning controls in Teams; all docs cover bots/agents/Graph API/apps, not personal notification settings. Community evidence actively describes the opposite experience — 'MS have not implemented muting as a feature... you can't unsubscribe yourself' and 'it's impossible to shut off notifications' — indicating this capability is not available as described.
